summary: REGISTRATION BUG FIXED - The registration endpoint is now working correctly. Root cause: Backend server was not restarted after RECAPTCHA_ENABLED=false was set in .env. After restarting the backend, registration works perfectly both via API and UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Small error badge visible in bottom-right corner showing 'ERROR fo Invalid do...' - likely related to reCAPTCHA script trying to load when disabled

passed_tests: Basic user registration works without reCAPTCHA token
Duplicate email correctly rejected with 400 error
Registration from France, Belgique, Suisse, Allemagne all work
IP blocking mechanism accessible (not blocking legitimate requests)
Health check endpoint returns healthy status
Frontend registration form loads correctly at /auth?mode=register
Frontend registration successfully redirects to dashboard after signup
action_items: CRITICAL FOR PRODUCTION: The production server (worldautofrance.com) needs to be RESTARTED for the RECAPTCHA_ENABLED=false change to take effect. The .env change alone is not enough - the server must be restarted to reload environment variables.
OPTIONAL: Remove or hide the reCAPTCHA script loading in frontend when RECAPTCHA_ENABLED=false to avoid the error badge in the corner
critical_code_review_comments: The reCAPTCHA check at line 1308-1313 in server.py is correctly implemented - it only runs when RECAPTCHA_ENABLED=true
The IP blocking mechanism (lines 46-100) is working correctly and not causing false positives
Environment variable loading at line 118 is correct: RECAPTCHA_ENABLED = os.environ.get('RECAPTCHA_ENABLED', 'false').lower() == 'true'

test_credentials.test_accounts_created: Multiple test accounts created with pattern test_*@test.com

seed_data_creation: Test user accounts created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Registration is working in preview environment after backend restart. The production server (worldautofrance.com) likely needs the same restart to apply the RECAPTCHA_ENABLED=false setting.

root_cause_analysis.issue: Registration failing with 'Vérification de sécurité échouée' error
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Backend server was not restarted after RECAPTCHA_ENABLED=false was set in .env file. The server was still running with the old cached value (RECAPTCHA_ENABLED=true).
evidence: After restart: Registration API works without reCAPTCHA token
After restart: Frontend registration flow completes successfully
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Restarted backend server with 'sudo supervisorctl restart backend'
root_cause_analysis.production_action_required: RESTART THE PRODUCTION SERVER to apply the .env change
